transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get our routine material-handling huddle started. We've got three moves tomorrow — the clinic cold-chain pallet, the generator skid, and the communications shelter crate — all going from the receiving yard to their assigned storage areas. Before I publish the final assignment, I need to confirm any updates on the receiving side, load planning, and equipment status. What are we seeing?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag an equipment constraint for tomorrow's moves. I measured the clinic receiving dock's turning radius this morning, and only electric forklift F-2 can enter and align with the cold-chain pallet position. I have the signed warehouse measurement, but the revised dock note hasn't been added to tomorrow's handling sheet yet. This means F-2 needs to be assigned to the cold-chain pallet move.

I have the scale record in hand, but I should note the receiving manifest still lists the old estimated weight, so anyone checking the manifest won't see the updated figure.
